comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Both two-digit expansions (seed 43, tens and ones) and three-digit expansions with hundreds (seed 500, "958 is 9 hundreds, 5 tens, and 8 ones") are represented.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: mcq, cloze, true_false, error_detect, and read_fill_in_blank formatters all wrap the same expanded-form scaffold.

competency_alignment.rationale: The varying element is addend size and digit count, staying inside the expanded-form addition skill.
